answer: The broken-links check in the Workbench's Maintenance tab is fed by the `aspiring-page` index object type (pages that are linked to but don't exist yet). An entry drops off the list when you create the target page, since that removes its aspiring-page entries. The records are also rebuilt whenever the source page is re-indexed (source: `Tag/aspiring-page.md`).

8	[[Aspiring Pages]] (codified using the `aspiring-page` tag) are pages that are linked to, but not yet created. [[Like this one]].

10	Internally SilverBullet uses these in the [[Workbench/Maintenance]] tab (as broken links), page complete and the page picker (to hint at pages to still be created).
